status: Conditional class/range evidence; no forced one-to-one mapping, no asset changes

policy.status: Read-only class-budget interpretation, not authored one-to-one product mapping
policy.procedure: Freeze semantic membership before running class_budget_review.py numeric comparisons. Earlier native counts were already visible: this is not a blinded selection. Include every listed candidate; no post-comparison removal or choosing only the upper bound.
policy.universe: Exactly30 mob(...) TemplateMob registrations in BlueprintEntities; run-03 final dispatcher native bake. No elites, Bosses, vanilla or pre-rework self models.
rules: Same measurement basis: all baked body cuboids and non-null quads, including baked accessories, excluding external equipment/layers. Quad is a quadrilateral, not a triangle. No filesize estimates, per-bone stripping or proportional rescaling.
Declare anatomical/skeleton or locomotion/role grouping first. A group budget is a conditional analogy, never an invented exact species correspondence or new game mechanic.

Use minimum AND maximum native counts across all candidates; test each candidate. <=minimum means all listed candidates meet; >maximum means none; otherwise only some. Never turn maximum into a universal pass threshold.
Civilian occupation/neutrality does not itself change geometry budget. Light humanoids compare against all light ordinary human rigs, retaining their actual lower Steve bake counts.
For no matching structural class, return null bounds and no-comparable-baseline. Do not divide an aggregate model into14 independent insects to force a per-insect comparison.
The previous19 proposed correspondences remain unchanged and are outside this eleven-item extension. Candidate outcomes are review findings, not authorization to reduce assets or change code/TODO.

light_human_biped.definition: 正常尺度人类的头、躯干、双臂、双腿与轻装衣甲；排除巨盾、明确重装护卫、大旗、畸形尸体、纸扎、鬼魂、树石构装和攀爬猿形骨架。
light_human_biped.tier: 骨架形态类比，职业/中立性不相同
light_human_biped.caveat: 次级Geo模型四肢分段多于COD1实际Steve模型，保留这项真实复杂度差异，不按骨骼归一化。冠、背篓、算盘与武器不同；COD1无中立交易/流民职业同型。

mobile_mammal_quadruped.definition: 非多节的陆生哺乳兽形躯干、头、尾和四肢支撑，能够连续地面移动；纳入以前肢承重的攀爬山魈，保留手掌解剖差异；排除以跳跃为主的蛙、背碑重壳龟、蛇和多足节肢。
mobile_mammal_quadruped.tier: 较宽的形态/移动骨架类比
mobile_mammal_quadruped.caveat: 没有精确猪/猫科COD1基怪。机械犬有齿轮附件，山魈有抓握前肢与攀爬差异；两者均纳入，不只选择较贵者。
mobile_mammal_quadruped.sensitivity_note: 进一步放宽到所有四肢支撑形态，才纳入蛙和重龟，单独报告完整下限/上限；不能拿重龟单独作为预算。

paired_wing_nonhumanoid.definition: 单一紧凑非人形躯干、头、一对主动振翅翼与爪；排除额外双翼的巨臂人形、无翼飞颅、浮空鱼和聚合虫群。
paired_wing_nonhumanoid.tier: 双翼粗类，非相同物种/完整骨架
paired_wing_nonhumanoid.caveat: COD1该组只有鬼面蝠。膜翼指骨不同于羽翼、鸟喙、尾羽及机械鸟关节；精确鸟类/机关鸟基准仍不存在。范围退化为单值不等于宣称物种一对一。

compact_wingless_airborne_ghost.definition: 独立紧凑、无翼、可离地自由漂浮、具有接触/诅咒/干扰用途的阴魂；排除依水生存的水鬼、大型纸轿与轿夫载具、主动振翅蝙蝠。这不是共享解剖骨架类。
compact_wingless_airborne_ghost.caveat: 没有纸钱本体或吸钱同型。飞颅触须、阴兵铠甲、裹布童子轮廓不同；在用途参考范围内满足，不能关闭精确形态预算的未定义状态。

no_comparable.snail_maiden: Shell+tail+human upper body/fins with retracting defense. No COD1 shelled humanoid. Bixi is a four-legged heavy turtle/stele, water ghost lacks shell, normal human rig lacks tail/shell; do not mix their budgets or choose a large turtle.
no_comparable.locust_swarm: One entity containing14 separately winged insect bodies in current model. No COD1 comparable aggregate flying swarm. Centipede is one long segmented body, spider/scorpion terrestrial single arthropods, paper palanquin is a vehicle/carrier complex; none defines a defensible matching geometry budget.

- **成员配置**：1名 橹盾甲士 + 2名 连弩阵卒 + 1名 拒马长枪兵
- 拒马长枪兵则游弋在盾甲士斜后方2格。一旦玩家试图使用疾跑、位移技能绕过巨盾强切后排弩手，拒马长枪兵立刻横向跨步上前使用【枪阵拒马】直接打断玩家冲刺并击晕，随后前排盾兵接盾击击飞，后排弩兵瞬间集火爆头。

- **成员配置**：1名 符法祭酒 + 2名 铁索斥候 + 3名 溃军死士
- 铁索斥候不直接攻击，而是从两侧极速绕后，向玩家投掷飞爪【锁镰飞掷】，强行打断玩家的撤退走位，将玩家往被强化的溃军死士怀里拖拽。
